The Author

About Alvin Silva, MDM

Resilience consultant, DRR and climate-adaptation practitioner, and systems thinker — writing for people who want to adapt without losing themselves.

Visit Alvin’s SiteGet the Book

Practitioner first, author second

Frameworks proven in the field, then written down

Alvin M. Silva holds a Master in Development Management from the Asian Institute of Management and has spent 18+ years in disaster risk reduction, climate-change adaptation, strategic planning, and systems innovation with governments, NGOs, and communities across the Philippines and beyond.

Personal Resilience: The Path to Oneness turns that practice inward. Its CASE Equation — R = C + A − S − E — treats the self as a system: strengthen coping capacity and adaptability, reduce sensitivity and exposure.

  • Author of five books, including Building Resilience and Resilient Futures
  • Founder of Cognitio+, an inclusive well-being platform
  • Lead architect of the Bangsamoro Investment Roadmap 2026–2035
